pageTitle: An Invitation to Memories From Mimo
name: Une invitation aux souvenirs de la part de Mimo
description: Snow has melted, and our journey goes on as we waltz into a blooming spring. Stories between you and HoYoLAB, as well as ones between you and Genshin Impact, will keep unfolding. Claim and open your exclusive report. There's also in-game rewards for you!
